command: docker image inspect acs-api:mvp-a1-local --format '{{.Id}}'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint python acs-api:mvp-a1-local -c "import hashlib,json,pathlib; print(json.dumps({p:hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/app/'+p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ['app/rag/retrieval.py','app/services/chat_prompt.py','app/services/conversations.py']}))"
